scenes.heading: VORK RENDERS THE SHOT
scenes.say: What if your agent could render the shot itself?

scenes.heading: A RENDERER FOR AGENTS
scenes.say: It's vork, a headless rendering engine built for agents: scenes are written as code and rendered on a GPU.

scenes.heading: NO EDITOR TO DRIVE
scenes.say: There's no editor. The agent writes a scene, renders a preview, looks at the image and revises the camera and the light.

scenes.heading: SHADER IN THE MIDDLE
scenes.say: It hands the agent geometry, ray queries and GPU compute, so a shot can carry its own shader.

scenes.heading: WHAT IT RENDERS
scenes.say: The examples run from a million self-steering birds to VFX cut into real footage.

idea: vork is a headless 3D and VFX engine where agents write scenes as code and render them on a GPU.

claims.text: vork is a headless 3D and VFX engine built for agents: scenes are written as code and rendered on a GPU.
There is no editor to drive: the agent writes a scene, renders a preview, looks at the image and revises the code.
It gives the agent geometry, ray queries and GPU execution, so a shot can carry its own shader.
The examples include a million self-steering birds, a black hole bending light, and VFX added to real footage.
